Terms of Service

Last updated: November 20, 2026 • Effective Version 2.4

1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using the NexusGuard platform, APIs, or open-source SDKs, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you are accessing on behalf of an organization or financial institution, you represent that you possess requisite authority.

2. Acceptable Use & AI Safety Compliance

NexusGuard is intended exclusively for authorized observability, performance evaluation, and safety governance of autonomous AI systems. You explicitly agree not to use the platform to:

  • Bypass or disable access control restrictions on third-party financial or LLM APIs.
  • Deploy autonomous agents designed for unauthorized credential stuffing or financial skimming.
  • Transcribe or transmit unconsented personally identifiable information (PII).

3. Third-Party Connector Guardrails

By default, all external fintech and payment connectors (e.g. bKash, Nagad, SSLCommerz) run in Simulator Mode using synthetic mock events. Transitioning to sandbox or live production APIs requires independent merchant verification, partner agreements, and formal institutional compliance sign-off.

4. Limitation of Liability

NexusGuard provides heuristic recommendations, precision scores, and automated circuit breakers as engineering aids. Final automated actions (e.g. blocking accounts, holding disbursements) must be configured with human-in-the-loop review thresholds.
